title: Extensor hallucis brevis
summary: The extensor hallucis brevis is a muscle on the top of the foot that helps to extend the big toe.

sections.heading: Structure
paragraphs: The extensor hallucis brevis is essentially the medial part of the extensor digitorum brevis muscle.
Some anatomists have debated whether these two muscles are distinct entities.
The extensor hallucis brevis arises from the calcaneus and inserts on the proximal phalanx of the digit 1 (the big toe).

sections.heading: Nerve supply
paragraphs: Nerve supplied by lateral terminal branch of Deep Peroneal Nerve (deep fibular nerve) (proximal sciatic branches S1, S2).
Same innervation of Extensor Digitorum Brevis

sections.heading: Function
paragraphs: The extensor hallucis brevis helps to extend the big toe.
